listening.title: Birinchi aytilgan javob tuzog'i

listening.title: Fifteen yoki fifty?
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Fifteen yoki fifty?: -teen va -ty bilan tugaydigan sonlar eng ko'p adashtiradigan joy. 💡 Qanday farqlash kerak: fifTEEN da urg'u oxirida, FIFty da boshida bo'ladi. -teen cho'ziqroq eshitiladi: fif-TEEEN. Mashq: kuniga 5 daqiqa 13–19 va 30–90 sonlarini juft qilib tinglang. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Word limit tuzog'i
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Word limit tuzog'i: Savolda NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS deyilgan, siz esa "a large garden" deb yozdingiz. Javob to'g'ri bo'lsa ham, ball yo'q. 💡 Oltin qoida: Limitni har bo'lim boshida aylana ichiga oling. A/an/the ham so'z hisoblanadi. Raqam (25) bitta son hisoblanadi, so'z emas. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Ism harflab aytilganda
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ism harflab aytilganda: "My surname is Thompson, that's T-H-O-M-P-S-O-N." Ko'pchilik P harfini tushirib qoldiradi. 💡 Oltin qoida: Harflar aytila boshlaganda faqat harflarni yozing, so'zni o'ylamang. Double S = SS, double T = TT. Oxirida harflarni sanab tekshiring. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Telefon raqamidagi "oh"
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Telefon raqamidagi "oh": "It's oh-seven-double-four..." Bu yerda oh harf emas, nol (0)! 💡 Esda tuting: oh = 0, double four = 44, triple five = 555. Raqamlarni 3-4 tadan guruhlab yozing, shunda adashmaysiz. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Savolni oldindan o'qimaslik
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Savolni oldindan o'qimaslik: Audio boshlanganda savolni endi o'qiyotgan bo'lsangiz, birinchi javob allaqachon o'tib ketgan. 💡 To'g'ri strategiya: Har bo'lim oldidan berilgan 30 soniyada keyingi savollarni o'qing va kalit so'zlarni chizib qo'ying. Bo'sh joyga qanday so'z kelishini taxmin qiling: son, ism, joy yoki fe'l? 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Bo'sh joyga qanday so'z kerak
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Bo'sh joyga qanday so'z kerak: "The course costs ___ per week." Bu yerga faqat narx keladi. Buni audio boshlanmasdan bilishingiz kerak. 💡 Bashorat qilish formulasi: Bo'sh joy oldi va keyingi so'zlarga qarang: a/an dan keyin birlikdagi ot, many dan keyin ko'plik, at dan keyin vaqt yoki joy. Grammatika javobning yarmini aytib beradi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Ko'plik qo'shimchasi -s
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ko'plik qo'shimchasi -s: "Bring two ___." Siz "towel" deb yozdingiz. Javob towels edi va ball ketdi. 💡 Oltin qoida: Ko'plikni eshitishga emas, gapning grammatikasiga ishoning. Son, some, several, a few bo'lsa, oxiriga -s qo'shishni tekshiring. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Xarita savollarida adashish
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Xarita savollarida adashish: Map labelling da spiker tez gapiradi, siz esa xaritada hali qayerdaligingizni topolmaysiz. 💡 3 qadamli usul: 1. Audio oldidan kirish joyini (entrance, you are here) toping. 2. Yo'nalish so'zlarini eslang: opposite, next to, beyond, to the left of. 3. Barmog'ingiz bilan spiker yo'lidan yuring. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Yo'nalish so'zlarini bilmaslik
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Yo'nalish so'zlarini bilmaslik: "The café is diagonally opposite the reception." Bu so'zni bilmasangiz, xarita savoli ketadi. 💡 Yodlab oling: opposite = qarshisida, adjacent to = yonma-yon, beyond = narida, at the far end = eng oxirida, clockwise = soat mili bo'yicha, halfway along = yo'lning o'rtasida. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Multiple choice tuzog'i
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Multiple choice tuzog'i: Spiker A, B va C variantlarning uchalasini ham tilga oladi. Faqat bittasi to'g'ri. 💡 Oltin qoida: Eshitilgan so'z emas, ma'no muhim. Ko'pincha noto'g'ri variant so'zma-so'z aytiladi, to'g'risi esa sinonim bilan. "cheap" varianti uchun audioda "it won't cost much" keladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Sinonimlarni tanimaslik
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Sinonimlarni tanimaslik: Savolda "free", audioda "complimentary". Kalit so'zni kutib o'tirsangiz, javobni o'tkazib yuborasiz. 💡 Ko'p uchraydigan juftlar: free = complimentary, no charge cheap = affordable, reasonable start = commence, kick off problem = issue, drawback increase = rise, go up 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Section 4 da yo'qolib qolish
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Section 4 da yo'qolib qolish: Ma'ruza 10 savolni uzluksiz o'qiydi, tanaffus yo'q. Bitta javobni o'tkazib yuborsangiz, keyingilari ham ketadi. 💡 Qutqaruvchi qoida: Javobni topolmasangiz, darhol keyingi savolga o'ting. Bitta savol uchun 3 tasini yo'qotmang. Signal so'zlarni kuzating: "Moving on to...", "Another factor is..." 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Signpost so'zlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Signpost so'zlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish: Ma'ruzachi yangi qismga o'tishini oldindan aytadi, siz esa buni eshitmaysiz. 💡 Bu so'zlar sizning xaritangiz: "First of all..." boshlanish "Turning now to..." yangi mavzu "However..." qarama-qarshi fikr "To sum up..." xulosa Ularni eshitsangiz, savollar ro'yxatida qayerdaligingizni tekshiring. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Sana yozishda xato
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Sana yozishda xato: Javob "the 3rd of March". Siz "March 3th" deb yozdingiz va ball yo'qotdingiz. 💡 Xavfsiz format: Sanani 3 March yoki March 3 ko'rinishida yozing. Oy nomini to'g'ri yozishni tekshiring: February, Wednesday, September eng ko'p xato qilinadigan so'zlar. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Imlo xatosi = 0 ball
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Imlo xatosi = 0 ball: Javobni to'g'ri eshitdingiz, lekin "accomodation" deb yozdingiz. IELTS da bu noto'g'ri javob. 💡 Eng ko'p xato qilinadigan so'zlar: accommodation (cc, mm) necessary (bitta c, ikkita s) environment (n ni unutmang) government library Shu ro'yxatni haftada bir marta diktant qiling. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Pul miqdorini noto'g'ri yozish
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Pul miqdorini noto'g'ri yozish: "It's twelve fifty." Bu 1250 emas, £12.50! 💡 Esda tuting: Narxlarda twelve fifty = 12.50, a hundred and twenty = 120. Valyuta belgisi (£, $) savolda bo'lsa, uni qayta yozmang. Faqat sonni yozing. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Vaqtni tushunmaslik
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Vaqtni tushunmaslik: "The tour starts at a quarter to nine." Ko'pchilik 9:15 deb yozadi. Aslida 8:45. 💡 Vaqt iboralari: quarter past nine = 9:15 quarter to nine = 8:45 half past six = 6:30 noon = 12:00, midnight = 00:00 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: "Not" so'zini eshitmaslik
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ "Not" so'zini eshitmaslik: "The museum is open daily, except on Mondays." Savol: qaysi kuni yopiq? Javob Monday. 💡 Inkor signallari: except, apart from, rather than, instead of, unless so'zlari ma'noni teskariga aylantiradi. Ularni eshitganda javob o'zgaradi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Ikki variantni tanlash savoli
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ikki variantni tanlash savoli: "Choose TWO letters, A–E." Siz A va C ni bitta katakka yozdingiz yoki faqat bittasini tanladingiz. 💡 Qoidalar: Har bir harf alohida savol hisoblanadi. Tartib muhim emas: A, C yoki C, A bir xil. Ikkalasini aniq bilmasangiz ham, ikkinchi katakni bo'sh qoldirmang. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Section 3 da kim nima dedi
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Section 3 da kim nima dedi: Ikki talaba va o'qituvchi bahslashadi. Savol: "Who suggests changing the topic?" Siz ovozlarni chalkashtirdingiz. 💡 Ovozni tanish usuli: Birinchi daqiqada har bir spikerning ismini va ovozini (erkak/ayol, baland/past) belgilab oling. Fikrga e'tibor bering: "I'm not convinced" = rozi emas, "Fair point" = rozi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Rozi bo'lish yoki bo'lmaslikni tushunmaslik
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Rozi bo'lish yoki bo'lmaslikni tushunmaslik: Section 3 da talaba "I suppose so, but..." deydi. Vaqt so'zlarini kuzating: first, then, after that, once this is done, finally. listening.title: Harflarni chalkashtirish
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Harflarni chalkashtirish: Ingliz alifbosida A va R, E va I, G va J o'zbek qulog'iga o'xshash eshitiladi. 💡 Esda tuting: A = "ey", E = "i:", I = "ay" G = "dji:", J = "djey" R = "a:", Y = "uay" Kuniga 2 daqiqa ismlarni harflab aytib mashq qiling. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

listening.title: Ulangan nutq (connected speech)
listening.text: 🎧 IELTS LISTENING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ulangan nutq (connected speech): "Wha-d'ya-wanna-do?" Bu aslida "What do you want to do?". speaking.title: Rozilik va norozilik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Rozilik va norozilik: "Some people say... Do you agree?" ❌ "Yes, I agree." 💡 Nuanslar: "I couldn't agree more." = to'liq rozi "I agree to some extent, but..." = qisman "I see their point, but..." = muloyim norozilik So'ng, albatta, sabab keltiring. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Javobni savol so'zlari bilan boshlash
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Javobni savol so'zlari bilan boshlash: "Do you like music?" ❌ "Yes, I like music." Savolni takrorladingiz. 💡 Paraphrase: ✅ "Absolutely, I'm a big fan, especially of jazz." ✅ "I can't live without it, to be honest." Savol so'zlarini takrorlamang, sinonim ishlating. Bu Lexical Resource ni ko'rsatadi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Kuchsiz boshlanish
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Kuchsiz boshlanish: Har javob "Emm... yes..." bilan boshlanadi. 💡 Ishonchli boshlash: "Definitely!" "Not really, to be honest." "That's a tough one." "Oh, I love that question." Birinchi so'z ishonch beradi va keyingi gaplar oson keladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Faqat o'qib mashq qilish
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Faqat o'qib mashq qilish: Speaking mavzularini o'qiysiz, lekin ovoz chiqarib gapirmaysiz. 💡 To'g'ri mashq: Har kuni 10 daqiqa ovoz chiqarib gapiring. Part 2 kartasini oling, 1 daqiqa tayyorlaning va 2 daqiqa gapiring. Telefonga yozib oling va qayta tinglang. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: O'zingizni yozib olmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ O'zingizni yozib olmaslik: Xatolaringizni bilmaysiz, chunki o'zingizni hech qachon eshitmagansiz. 💡 Yozib olish usuli: Javobingizni telefonga yozing. Tinglab, 3 narsani belgilang: takrorlangan so'zlar, uzoq pauzalar va grammatik xatolar. Keyin xuddi shu savolga qayta javob bering. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Sherik bilan mashq qilmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Sherik bilan mashq qilmaslik: Yolg'iz tayyorlanasiz va jonli suhbatga o'rganmagansiz. 💡 Mashq usuli: Do'stingiz bilan haftada 2 marta examiner va nomzod rolida mashq qiling. Rollarni almashtiring. Bir-biringizga vaqt o'lchang va bitta asosiy xatoni ayting. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Mavzular bo'yicha so'z yo'q
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Mavzular bo'yicha so'z yo'q: Part 1 mavzulari takrorlanadi, lekin har biri uchun so'zingiz kam. 💡 Top Part 1 mavzular: Ish/o'qish, uy, shahar, hobbi, musiqa, sport, ovqat, sayohat, telefon, ob-havo. Har biri uchun 10 ta so'z va 1 ta shaxsiy hikoya tayyorlang. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Bitta hikoyani ko'p mavzuga moslash
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Bitta hikoyani ko'p mavzuga moslash: Har Part 2 kartasi uchun yangi hikoya o'ylab topish qiyin. 💡 Aqlli tayyorgarlik: 5-6 ta universal hikoya tayyorlang: sayohat, muhim odam, qiyin vaziyat, sovg'a, yutuq. Bitta sayohat hikoyasi "a place", "a happy memory", "a journey" kartalariga mos keladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Haddan tashqari rasmiy til
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Haddan tashqari rasmiy til: "Furthermore, it is my firm conviction that..." Speaking da bu yozma tilga o'xshaydi. 💡 Suhbat tili: Speaking da tabiiy gapiring: ❌ Furthermore, moreover ✅ On top of that, also, plus ❌ In conclusion ✅ So, all in all 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Qisqartmalarni ishlatmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Qisqartmalarni ishlatmaslik: "I do not know. I am not sure. It is good." Robot kabi eshitiladi. 💡 Tabiiy nutq: Speaking da qisqartmalar tabiiy: I'm, don't, it's, I'd, I've, can't. Writing dan farqli o'laroq, bu ballni oshiradi va nutqni ravonroq qiladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Chunking: tayyor bo'laklar
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Chunking: tayyor bo'laklar: Har gapni so'zma-so'z tuzasiz va sekin gapirasiz. 💡 Tayyor bo'laklar: "to be honest", "as far as I know", "the thing is", "at the end of the day", "when it comes to". Bunday bo'laklar miyaga vaqt beradi va nutqni tezlashtiradi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Ohang bilan qiziqish ko'rsatmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ohang bilan qiziqish ko'rsatmaslik: Sevimli hobbingiz haqida ham zerikkan ohangda gapirdingiz. 💡 Emotsiya: Qiziqishingizni ohang bilan ko'rsating. Yuzingizda tabassum bo'lsa, ovozingiz ham jonliroq eshitiladi. Examiner muloqot qobiliyatini ham his qiladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Ko'z bilan aloqa qilmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ko'z bilan aloqa qilmaslik: Butun intervyu davomida stolga qarab gapirdingiz. 💡 Tana tili: Ko'z kontakti va tabiiy imo-ishora sizni ishonchli ko'rsatadi va xotirjamlik beradi. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri baholanmaydi, lekin nutq ravonligiga yordam beradi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Imtihon kuni birinchi marta gapirish
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Imtihon kuni birinchi marta gapirish: Ertalabdan hech kim bilan gaplashmay imtihonga kirdingiz. Birinchi javoblar qiyin chiqdi. 💡 Isinish: Imtihondan oldin 15 daqiqa inglizcha podkast tinglang va ovoz chiqarib takrorlang. Yo'lda o'zingizga inglizcha gapiring. Til mushaklari ham isinishni talab qiladi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Band descriptorsni bilmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Band descriptorsni bilmaslik: Qanday baholanishini bilmasdan tayyorlanasiz. 💡 4 mezon: Fluency & Coherence: ravonlik va mantiq Lexical Resource: so'z boyligi Grammar: xilma-xillik va aniqlik Pronunciation: tushunarlilik Har biri 25%. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Fluency ni noto'g'ri tushunish
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Fluency ni noto'g'ri tushunish: Fluency = tez gapirish deb o'ylaysiz. 💡 Haqiqiy Fluency: Fluency bu uzluksiz va mantiqiy nutq. Tezlik emas, ravonlik. Fikrlarni bog'lash: "The main reason is... Another thing is... So overall...". Mantiqiy oqim tezlikdan muhimroq. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Mavzuni bilmasangiz
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Mavzuni bilmasangiz: "Describe a piece of art you like." Siz san'atga umuman qiziqmaysiz. 💡 Qutqaruvchi usul: Mavzuni o'zingizga yaqinlashtiring: rasm emas, telefoningizdagi sevimli surat, ko'chadagi graffiti yoki kitob muqovasi. Halollik ham mumkin: "I'm not really into art, but..." 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Javobni "So" bilan tugatmaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Javobni "So" bilan tugatmaslik: Gapingiz to'satdan tugaydi va examiner davom etasizmi deb kutadi. 💡 Yakunlash iboralari: "So yeah, that's why I love it." "So, all in all, it was a great experience." "Anyway, that's pretty much it." Aniq yakun examinerga tugaganingizni bildiradi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Tayyorgarlikni kechiktirish
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Tayyorgarlikni kechiktirish: "Speaking ni oxirida tayyorlayman" deb qoldirdingiz. 💡 To'g'ri reja: Speaking eng sekin rivojlanadigan ko'nikma. Imtihondan kamida 6-8 hafta oldin har kuni 15 daqiqa gapirishni boshlang. Kunlik odat haftalik marafondan samaraliroq. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz

speaking.title: Ingliz tilida o'ylamaslik
speaking.text: 🗣 IELTS SPEAKING | 1 MINUTE HACK ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ⚠️ Ingliz tilida o'ylamaslik: Avval o'zbekcha o'ylab, keyin tarjima qilasiz. Shuning uchun gap sekin va g'alati chiqadi. 💡 Inglizcha o'ylash mashqi: Kun davomida atrofingizdagi narsalarni ichingizda inglizcha tasvirlang: "I'm waiting for the bus. It's late again." Kuniga 5 daqiqa. 3 haftada tarjima qilish odati kamayadi. 💡 IELTSga tayyorlanayotgan do'stlaringizga ham ulashing! 👉 Telegram: @dilshod_english 📸 Instagram: instagram.com/dilshod.ustoz
